meta: Asking AI to summarize a long reading is fast, but you forget a skimmed summary. Ask AI for a map first, read the key part yourself, then let AI quiz you.

muc.title: Fifty pages of reading
muc.text: The lecturer assigns fifty pages before class, and asking AI to summarize is the fastest way, but not the best.

muc.title: Ask for a map first
muc.text: First ask AI to map the document: the main sections, the main idea of each, and which part matters most for your course.

muc.title: Read the key part yourself
muc.text: Then read the important part carefully yourself, and when something is hard, paste that passage into AI and ask for a simpler example.

muc.title: Let AI quiz you
muc.text: When you're done, ask AI to ask you five questions about the document. If you can answer, you've really understood it, not just skimmed a summary.

muc.title: Map, read, get quizzed
muc.text: With this week's course reading, ask AI for a map, read one part carefully, then let AI ask you five questions.
